name: firework-pop-glyphs
title: Firework Pop Glyphs
description: Celebration typography: on trigger, each glyph fires once — pops upward with rotation, bursts into two spark pseudo-elements that fly apart, then the glyph re-seats with an overshoot settle. One shot per click.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Airy
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Click Trigger One Shot: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
